name: @ecoma-io/llm-api
//: Deploy unit `llm-api` — data plane LLM tren Cloudflare Workers, runtime
TypeScript (Hono + pg driver qua Hyperdrive), bundle esbuild ra
build/index.js (Nx target `build`).
`pg` nam o dependencies cho `db/apply.mts` — migration runner chay o CI
runner (Node), khong thuoc bundle Worker (HD6: Hyperdrive khong ho tro
advisory lock). Nguon `pg` runtime cua Worker cung la dependency nay:
mot pg.Client moi cho moi phep goi SQL duoi `src/connections.ts`
(nodejs_compat bat o wrangler.jsonc; pg Pool co cache client idle qua
workerd bi v o tang platform — xem ho tinh connections.ts).
Ba domain lib `@ecoma-io/llm-*-domain` chi phuc vu bootstrap runner 8a/8b
duoi `db/` (chay tren Node qua tsx, khong thuoc bundle Worker): domain op
la duong code duy nhat de seed, khong co SQL ghi du lieu tu do.
`hono` la runtime HTTP cua Worker (src/index.ts).
`testcontainers` chi phuc vu suite integration app-owned duoi `tests/`.
Bundle Worker runtime TS (src/index.ts, Hono + pg) thanh artifact
build/index.js — dung duong dan + ten entry ma `wrangler.jsonc` main
tro vao (deploy unit hard-code target name `build`).
`external` node:buffer/node:events/node:stream la node builtins ma
driver `pg` doi hoi khi chay qua Hyperdrive (cung bo voi
apps/pact-broker-api; wrangler.jsonc bat `nodejs_compat` tuong minh).
conditions workerd/worker/browser cho esbuild resolve dung nhánh
browser/workerd cua `pg`; platform neutral + format esm.
Runner migration canonical (02-delivery.md §3): chay o CI runner voi
credential migrator cua tung DB (db-llm-gateway / db-llm-tenant /
db-llm-marketplace). Target luon khong cacheable vi no mutate DB that.
Target `test` = unit test colocated voi subject (06-testing.md §4).
Spec nam trong src/ ben canh file nguon cua no (port cua unit test
Rust cu). Suite integration (PostgreSQL that qua testcontainers)
nam o target `test-integration` voi config rieng.
Khong `build` trong dependsOn: unit spec khong doc artifact build.

options.command: npx vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.mts tests/integrations tests/databases

//: Suite integration app-owned (PostgreSQL that qua testcontainers):
ranh gioi quyen runtime/migrator, serialization advisory lock,
migration idempotent. Suite database import thang TS nguon
(`db/apply.mts`) — khong doc artifact build.
`dependsOn: build` cho suite HTTP contract (`tests/integrations/http-
contract.spec.ts`, review PR #113): suite boot runtime Worker that
tu artifact `build/index.js` ma target `build` (esbuild) sinh ra —
thieu artifact thi harness `listen()` nem ngay, do thay vi pass rong.
Cung hinh `test-integration` cua `apps/backoffice`.
Lint TS toan project (src/, tests/, db/, config) bang oxlint —
runtime da la TypeScript, khong con mat Rust (rustfmt/clippy) nao.
Solution reference hai project con: tsconfig.app.json (runtime
Worker src/) va tsconfig.spec.json (spec + db + harness integration).
